positions.name: CalibrationRecordFormalization
positions.frame: when the calibration result is recast as structured field-label entries, whose standing does the record speak from?
positions.why: src-2 and src-3 both restate the same calibration content from src-1 in a bolded field-label format ('**Instrument**:', '**Calibration**:'), and both carry the same footing split — Xena ExpertGH as animator/author, Quill Ashgrove as principal. This is a distinct directional read from src-1: the register shifts from narrative technical prose to protocol-observing field entries, and the relational reading shifts from communal-sharing ('We verified') to authority-ranking (a labeled record asserting a principal's standing to define the instrument and ratify the value). The two field-label lines cohere as one act of formalizing the calibration into a structured record; src-1 remains the free-standing narrative source and is left ungrouped.
